# Third-party scripts

## heic2any.min.js

- heic2any 0.0.4 — https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any — MIT License, Copyright (c) 2020 Alex Corvi.
- Bundles libheif (https://github.com/strukturag/libheif), LGPL-3.0, compiled to JavaScript.
- Loaded only in the browser, and only when a shopper picks a HEIC/HEIF photo the browser cannot open itself.
